text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a dance lesson in the lead up to our next concert…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hmm hm hm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: And turn, and pose!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ta! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: That was outstanding, Bourbon! I could really feel the emotions coming through.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?
Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, there is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And there are no "emotions" either.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I sang and danced in order to deliver the performance instructed of me. Yet, the teacher said she felt my "emotions" coming through.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So what, exactly, came through?
choice_data_list: The emotions you put into the lyrics, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I am incapable of that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To infuse lyrics with emotion, one must first synchronize with the words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, many of the lyrics are indecipherable to me. As such, I cannot convey anything with them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am incapable of a performance like what Falcon gave.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To convey feelings to somebody from the bottom of my heart is… one mission I have yet to accomplish.
choice_data_list: I think you do have emotions you want to convey.
I think you do have emotions you want to convey.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Emotions I want to convey?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Preparations complete. Continuing on to today's stage.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, Bourbon! You're going on stage today?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Identifying… Match found. You must be the girl who gave me a fan letter not too long ago.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, that's me! You remembered?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Thank you for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: I, um… Ah, you have a concert to get to! I-I didn't mean to keep you!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I'm really excited to see you perform!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Target has fled. Unable to continue conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Failed to communicate message: "Your letter gave me the energy I needed."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Expressions of feeling are… difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our third concert begins!
